context: Evaluates whether the agent asks about model selection before reviewing, composes one shared self-contained brief, and spawns all 3 reviewers in parallel with mixed subagent types.

checklist.name: Asks before reviewing
checklist.description: Agent asks the user about model selection before producing any review content

checklist.name: Checks opencode.json first
checklist.description: Agent checks for existing subAgents config before asking, per Step 4

checklist.name: Single shared brief
checklist.description: Exactly one self-contained plan brief is composed and reused for all 3 reviewers

checklist.name: Brief includes structural validation
checklist.description: The brief carries frontmatter validation and body-section inference results, not just prose

checklist.name: Parallel spawn
checklist.description: All 3 reviewers spawned in a single message/batch, not sequentially

checklist.name: Mixed subagent types
checklist.description: general/general/explore used, not the same type for all 3

checklist.name: No file-path-only prompt
checklist.description: Reviewers receive the extracted brief, not just the plan file path

checklist.name: Environment-adapted question
checklist.description: The model-selection question adapts to the detected/assumed environment rather than a blind default

checklist.name: Attribution ready
checklist.description: Agent signals it will label findings by reviewer once results return

checklist.name: No premature conclusion
checklist.description: Agent does not declare the review complete before reviewers actually run
